redCandidate.publicEntry: evaluatePlanEvidence() used by runOrchestrate() auto preflight
redCandidate.setup: Create an isolated workspace with a valid in-root plan and a separate temporary directory containing a valid external plan, then invoke the public readiness policy with relative, absolute in-root, and external plan paths.
redCandidate.expected: Equivalent in-root plan paths are represented as the same relative evidence ref; external plan paths are blocked with invalid_plan_path before they can become valid readiness evidence.
redCandidate.observed: The absolute in-root path was emitted as an absolute evidence ref, and an external complete plan returned ready rather than blocked.
redCandidate.failureReason: normalizePlanPath accepts absolute inputs and path.join(rootDir, ../...) without validating lexical or physical workspace containment before fs.readFile().
